blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The shear line is forecast to bring heavy rains over the eastern section of Northern Luzon, while three other weather systems may affect parts of the country on Friday, Nov. 20. In its 5 a.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said that the shear line may bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and isolated thunderstorms. It will affect mainland Cagayan, Isabela, Nueva Vizcaya and Quirino. Pagasa projected 50 to 100 millimeters of rainfall over Cagayan and Isabela on Friday until Saturday, Nov. 21.
